name: Haguro Akane
source: Daughter of lord Haguro Genjou by a concubine, making her Manahime's half-sister. Treated as an outsider (the concubine's child) since Manahime's birth shortly after her own, this complex fueled her passion for martial arts. She grew into one of the Four Heavenly Kings. Known as the 'Galloping Princess Warrior' for leading her cavalry swiftly across the battlefield. She trained swordsmanship alongside her senior Uneme, her senior in both age and swordsmanship by seven years, and has looked up to him like an older brother since childhood, harboring secret feelings she never shows. She hates being called "Princess" and often fights with Uneme over it.
